correctness.rationale: The seven simple common zeros of yz(3x-s),xz(3y-s),xy(3z-s), s=x+y+z, are precisely three coordinate vertices, three points on a coordinate line with s=0, and [1:1:1]. The seven-point cubic evaluation matrix has rank 7; the three cubics give the complete base-point-free anticanonical net on the blowup. The generic inverse λ obeys abc λ²-2(ab+ac+bc)λ+3(a+b+c)=0 after removal of the base-point root. Its discriminant B=(ab+ac+bc)²-3abc(a+b+c) factors over roots of unity into two nonsingular conics meeting transversely at the four explicit rational points, hence precisely four A1 surface singularities. Strict transforms of x=0,y=0,z=0,s=0 have self-intersection -2 and resolve them. Frobenius either fixes both conics (2q-2 branch points if q≡1 mod3) or exchanges them (4 if q≡2 mod3), for finite fields char>3. Verified factorization symbolically, all cubic base equations and rank, and branch counts q=5,7,11,13; these finite checks are not the proof for arbitrary q.
